name: Sikkim State Day
description: Statewide civic celebration marking Sikkim's statehood, with the Chief Minister's address broadcast live and parades across all districts.

name: Pang Lhabsol
description: Unique Sikkimese festival honouring Mount Khangchendzonga as guardian deity, observed by all communities with masked Cham dances at monasteries statewide.

name: Losoong & Namsoong
description: Bhutia and Lepcha New Year celebrations — Sikkim's biggest indigenous festival season, with archery contests, masked dances and community feasts.

name: International Flower Festival
description: Month-long flagship flower show showcasing Sikkim's orchids and rhododendrons — a major tourism draw held at White Hall grounds.

name: Sikkim Marathon
description: Annual long-distance run through Gangtok and the surrounding hills, drawing runners from across the Northeast and beyond.

name: Dashain & Tihar
description: The largest festive season for Sikkim's Nepali-majority population — Vijaya Dashami's tika ceremonies followed by Tihar's Deepawali lighting.
